crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
“No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container, or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those…
“No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see…
You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
“Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’…

translations.web: Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
translations.bsb: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
translations.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
translations.asv: Neither do men light a lamp, and put it under the bushel, but on the stand; and it shineth unto all that are in the house.
